Symbol style

Keyboard shortcuts & editing help

V Select · O Circle · C Connect · B Bend · E Erase · F Fill selection · D Dotted stroke · G Grid · S Snap
Ctrl / ⌘ A selects all. Arrow keys move selected points. Delete removes a selection. Escape cancels a drag.
Ctrl / ⌘ Z Undo · Ctrl / ⌘ Shift Z Redo
Drag a line in Select or Bend to shape it. Every slider has ten stops. Distortion amount controls vector warp amplitude; Distortion scale controls its frequency. Drag from a line in Connect to create a junction.

Click a symbol below to edit it. Change its title to rename it, then Save edits. Save variation creates a separate copy.
